notes: Example only: the driver marks the controller value and the calibrated reader position operator_required because no text file of the clone states a travel or voltage range for an installed stage. Replace these numbers with the limits of the installed stage before any use; they are not a statement about any device. The value unit changes with the loop mode: in closed loop it is percentage travel and in open loop it is output voltage.

value.reason: example only: the operator supplies the permitted percentage travel or output voltage of the installed stage in the mode in use

position.reason: example only: the operator supplies the permitted strain gauge reading in the reader display unit
